dedupe_keys.name: is 50v national topographic database of iceland roads airports structures hydrography and boundaries 1 50 000

description: IS 50V is Iceland's national vector topographic database at 1:50,000, maintained by the Natural Science Institute, which absorbed the former National Land Survey (Landmælingar Íslands). Contents: themes for transport (a line layer of the national road network with road type, surface, classification, road numbers and data owner, 58,285 segments on 29 September 2026, and a polygon layer of airports), structures (mannvirki, 23,607 point features such as buildings, masts, dams and other installations, plus polygons), hydrography, coastline, elevation contours and spot heights, land surface, place names and administrative boundaries. Producer: the Natural Science Institute, with road geometry supplied or verified by the Road Administration (Vegagerðin); the edition served was dated 25 August 2026. Coverage: all of Iceland. Format and access: GeoPackage downloads and WMS and WFS services on the institute's GeoServer, described in the national GeoNetwork catalogue, with a web map at kort.lmi.is. Free; the metadata record states no separate licence. Caveats: 1:50,000 accuracy suits national studies but not local engineering, attribute names and code lists are in Icelandic, and many rural tracks are included alongside public roads. Simulation uses: a national road graph for accessibility and detour analysis, exposure of roads and structures to volcanic, flood and avalanche hazards, and base layers for Icelandic infrastructure models. Related records: Vegagerðin road and traffic services (data-vegagerdin-road-data-services), the Reykjanes volcanic hazard map (data-imo-reykjanes-volcanic-hazard-map) and Fjarskiptastofa telecom layers (data-fjarskiptastofa-iceland-coverage-masts-and-fibre-layers).
